Pane ownership — Topbar: Current working-context identity only (workspace name, active module, profile). No environment switcher. No workspace-within-workspace.

Pane ownership — Rail: Exactly five module destinations. Annals becomes a contextual destination within Records (Canon/Annals/Roll query concept). APT Coin Lab becomes Intelligence sub-view (research). School Console becomes Workbench nested boundary. Current STUDIO_FLOW_MODULES has 4; need to reconcile to 5 with Intelligence or keep 4 + secondary.

Pane ownership — Sidebar: Within-module context only (filtered views, scoped navigation, local filters). Not a second module navigator. Collapses to 0 on mobile. Network module's three sub-contexts (people/institutions/capabilities) is correct within-module navigation.
Pane ownership — Main: Work surface only. Page head follows L1/L2/L3 hierarchy. No fixed four-metric header. Build PageHead component with L1/L2/L3 slots.

Pane ownership — Inspector: One shared record-detail primitive (relationships, evidence gaps, context actions, gate status). Opens on record selection, closes on deselect. Resizable. Requires record-selection state shared across modules (future work).

Pane ownership — Dock: Per-module live change-set / ledger strip replacing static Source/Related/History link tray. Shows pending commits, evidence gaps, reconciliation queue. Collapsible. Requires module-specific change-set state (future work).

Pane ownership — Statusbar: Single boundary line + ledger head state (current canonical head, pending count, sync status). No module label duplication. Reduce from current 'APT-LABS / {module} · BROWSER-LOCAL WORKSPACE DEMO'.

Signature devices — KEEP: Surveyor grid (24px) as subtle background on work surfaces; Fork glyph (└─) as identity device only (not navigation); Ringed evidence markers (● with ring) on events/records; 24px survey lines as structural rhythm; Three type tiers (serif record names, sans UI, mono readouts); Glassmorphic topbar (backdrop-filter blur). CUT: Gradients as primary fills; All-caps micro-labels; Motion not responding to user action; Generic AI dashboard layouts; Decorative metrics with no operational meaning.

Page head L1/L2/L3 hierarchy: L1 (always) serif record/page name; L2 (when facts exist) mono readout line (ID, timestamp, state, head); L3 (max 3, only when driving decision) metrics with 2px left border, first in teal. Intelligence page gets only L1+L2 (exploratory, no decision-driving metrics).

Type system: Three tiers — Serif (Georgia) for record/page names; System sans (Inter) for interface text; Monospace (JetBrains Mono) for IDs, timestamps, counts, state labels, L2/L3 readouts. Uppercase mono ONLY for informational pane headers (rail tooltips, sidebar section labels, dock tab labels, statusbar) — never for content, buttons, or page head. Audit existing .uppercase utility usage.
